E2427

`$caller` is legal only as a parameter default or inside an #Expand macro.

What

`$caller` is legal only as a parameter default or inside an #Expand macro.

Why

`$caller` is the place of the call that left the parameter out; anywhere else there is no call to name.

Fix

Declare a parameter `at: SourceLocation{$caller}` and read `at`, or write `$here` for this line.
